title: Algolia write API key: a role carried in a header shared with every other role
summary: A write API key (a key whose ACL holds addObject, deleteObject, deleteIndex or editSettings) in the x-algolia-api-key header, a variable or a configuration file.
rationale: Algolia states that write-access keys must not be used in frontend code or mobile apps (claim write-api-key-handling) and lists the write ACLs (claim write-api-key-write-acls). The only carrier the pages show is the x-algolia-api-key header, shared by every role whatever its ACL, so the header name does not identify a write key (claim write-api-key-header-carrier); the role is attributable from a variable name, a description or an ACL only, none of which Algolia documents as a marker. Whether the predefined Write key and a custom key with write ACLs are one family or two (open-question-3), the ACL set of the predefined key (open-question-5) and its relation to the Admin key (open-question-6) are open. A role-specific positive would rest on a marker the evidence does not name. Contract claims cited: write-api-key/write-api-key-handling, write-api-key/write-api-key-write-acls, write-api-key/write-api-key-header-carrier.

expectation.rationale: No outcome is asserted. Settled by: an Algolia page that names a marker or a dedicated carrier for the predefined Write key, or states its ACLs and its relation to custom write keys.

sources.supports: Don't use write-access keys in frontend code or mobile apps, and use environment variables for API keys in your code instead of hardcoding them.
Add records (addObject): allowed to add or update records in the index.
Delete records (deleteObject): allowed to delete an existing record.
Delete index (deleteIndex): allowed to delete an index.
Set index settings (editSettings): allowed to update all index settings.
Your Algolia API key with the necessary permissions to make the request. Permissions are controlled through access control lists (ACL) and access restrictions.
The ACL defines each allowed feature for a given API key.
